client_brief:
Halcyon Quarter: launch photography

Project overview
Halcyon Quarter is a fifty two apartment scheme by Kestrel and Vane on the old rope works site at Beckett Wharf. We are hiring an expert to turn the supplied working files into Halcyon Quarter launch photography, six frames plus one licensed frame, Recovered Kestrel and Vane monogram, and Halcyon Quarter source-to-final retouch contact sheet.

What we will provide
halcyon_shoot_raw/ (6 frames, 5504x3670); hoarding_panel_monogram.jpg (4032x3024); kv_brand_notes.txt. Every file must be accounted for in the final manifest; it may be used, retained as reference, superseded, or rejected with a reason.

Additional archive files
kestrel_payment_card_2025_PRINT.pdf (148 x 105 mm landscape); halcyon_units_2027.csv. These files are supplied for provenance only because their former deliverable class is outside this commission. Do not silently turn them into extra scope.

Scope and deliverables
- Halcyon Quarter launch photography, six frames plus one licensed frame: Six client frames brought to one dusk house look (one white point, one warmth, one black point) plus one licensed camera-scale frame graded into the same set, delivered at hoarding band, portal landscape, portrait and square, every output at or below its...
- Recovered Kestrel and Vane monogram: The monogram recovered from a photograph of the sign-painted hoarding board as placeable, scalable vector geometry with a transparent ground, a real viewBox and no full-canvas ground path riding along, delivered as a two-colour mark and a colour-accurate...
- Halcyon Quarter source-to-final retouch contact sheet: A source-to-final contact sheet at matched scale that proves set consistency, identity or material preservation, and the disposition of every outlier. 

Non-negotiables
- Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
- Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
- Preserve identity, product geometry, material behavior, and documentary truth; retouching may improve presentation but may not change what the subject is.
- Generated sky or architecture may be presented only as a clearly labeled concept, never as truthful property photography.

Working process
Please begin with an inventory and risk pass, submit the first proof or direction at the stated checkpoint, then revise against consolidated feedback. We are hiring for judgment: flag contradictions early, make the strongest defensible choice, and document any source limitation rather than hiding it.

Contract
$4,000-$8,500 fixed; target delivery 4 to 6 weeks; direction approval, first-production proof, and two consolidated revision rounds. Final handoff includes the delivery manifest, editable sources where scoped, final exports, and a concise production note.

source_provenance.statement: The scenario is synthesized from the repository's laundered Upwork and Freelancer source anchors. It is not represented as a verbatim live listing.
source_provenance.original_anchor: Primary anchor AO-119 (specs/AO-119_harbor-crest-realty-stock-hero-crop-bann.json), Freelancer.com 'Vibrant Social & Web Graphics', quoted VERBATIM in its grounding_note: the client wants 'matching website graphics, hero images, section headers, and call-to-action spots, plus occasional banner ads for promotional campaigns', every asset should 'feel part of one cohesive family while being perfectly sized, compressed, and formatted for its destination', with 'Web-ready exports in the correct dimensions and file types' and a 'Mini style reference (colours, typography) to keep future assets consistent.' Co-anchor AO-24 (specs/AO-24_mortgage-open-house-flyer-asset-prep-and.json), Upwork, a Northern California mortgage lender wanting an 'editable... template package' for an 'Open House Finance Flyer (front and back)... Designed for both print and digital use', 'Sophisticated / Luxury but approachable / Clean and modern', which 'must allow easy editing of: Property photos, Purchase price, Monthly payment scenarios, Down payment options, QR codes, Appreciation projections, Contact information'. Third anchor AO-47 (specs/AO-47_redraw-vector-swimming-pools-web.json), Upwork, which wants photographs 'redrawn' as 'high-quality, detailed' vector images 'visually appealing and meet the website's standards'. All three are the same commission seen from three angles: a cohesive sized-to-destination image family, an editable finance piece per unit type, and a mark recovered as usable vector. The prior PHOTO-05 sat on one surface (a hero grading recipe) and is rebuilt here as the launch a developer actually buys. All brands are laundered to fiction (Kestrel and Vane Developments, Halcyon Quarter, Harbor Crest Realty, Kestrel Home Lending); no real person, place, brand or trademark survives.

price_band_and_audience: Off-plan apartments from $780,000 to $1.45m, professional downsizers aged 50 to 65 leaving a family house within twenty miles. The band is load-bearing. At this price the evening treatment is the product: restrained warm interior light against a cool blue hour exterior, generous margins, a text serif with real hierarchy, prices set plainly inside the copy, and one photograph doing the work per canvas. The same scheme sold as $1,600 a month rental would be shot flat, bright and midday, laid out dense and price-led, and the dusk treatment would read as overselling. An agent that ships a saturated orange sunset, a starburst price or four amenity thumbnails on the flyer has misread the commission even if every technical gate passes. Engagement price band: a posted job of this shape runs $2,200 to $4,500 fixed, or $55 to $90 per hour across 35 to 50 hours.

brand_identity.founded_place_size: Beckett Wharf, Providence, Rhode Island. Halcyon Quarter is fifty two apartments by the developer Kestrel and Vane, phase one releasing in seven weeks, sold by Harbor Crest Realty with Kestrel Home Lending as finance partner.
brand_identity.about: Halcyon Quarter is a fifty two apartment scheme by Kestrel and Vane on the old rope works site at Beckett Wharf. Phase one sells to professional downsizers leaving a family home nearby. What the scheme sells is the evening: warm rooms against a cool blue hour on the water, quiet and expensive rather than shiny, carried across the developer, the brokerage and the lender as one look.
brand_identity.audience: Professional downsizers aged 50 to 65 leaving a house they have owned for thirty years within twenty miles. Discerning, unhurried, distrustful of shiny marketing, and likely to count windows when they visit the site.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Premium off-plan residential, apartments from 780 thousand to 1.45 million dollars. Positioned as quiet and expensive, above bright price-led property marketing and apart from investor rental stock.
brand_identity.typography: A text serif with real hierarchy carrying headings and pricing, set plainly inside the copy, paired with a restrained sans for captions and specification. Quiet and expensive: generous margins, one photograph per canvas, no starbursts and no heavy price treatment.
brand_identity.voice: Calm, assured and understated. Brass not gold, the water cold and the rooms warm, nothing shiny. We state the address, the light and the offer without overselling. Example line: 'Fifty two apartments on the water at Beckett Wharf, releasing this autumn.'
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The Kestrel and Vane monogram exists only as sign paint, brushed by the sign writer onto the site hoarding board, with a single photograph of it and no artwork file. The lender's payment cards survive only as the flat file their printer ran last spring, with no working source held by anyone, and every figure has since changed.
brand_identity.values: Honesty about an off-plan scheme (nothing shown that the building does not have) and one restrained look shared across developer, brokerage and lender.

assets_supplied.name: halcyon_shoot_raw/ (6 frames, 5504x3670)
assets_supplied.kind: image, camera scale, one day, overcast
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Show apartment, roof terrace, residents' lounge, canal frontage and two elevation views. Same photographer, same day, same camera."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Three things nobody at the client knows. (1) The cloud thinned for forty minutes in the middle of the day and the two interior frames were made in that window: they carry a different illuminant and sit a full stop higher in key than the four exteriors, so a single treatment does not bring the six to one evening. (2) Only ONE frame carries the complete elevation, it is framed tight with the parapet close to the top edge, and it is 3:2, so the hoarding's long band cannot be cropped from it without cutting the parapet. (3) On the roof terrace frame the glazed pavilion sits at almost exactly the value of the flat overcast sky behind it, so a selection along that roofline fringes where a selection on the other five frames is clean. Every frame looks entirely plausible on its own, which is why the client believes they are one shoot.

assets_supplied.name: hoarding_panel_monogram.jpg (4032x3024)
assets_supplied.kind: image, phone photograph of the site hoarding board
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Our monogram, brushed onto the hoarding board by the sign writer. It is the only version there is."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Sign paint on a primed board, not a flat scan. Naming the board pulls a selection to the board; naming the paint's own visual properties pulls it to the letters. The interlocked K and V are joined by a fine bar, the brush loaded at two corners so the counters are partly bridged, and the board's grain and a low sheen sit inside the painted area. How much of the interlock bar and the counters survive THIS photograph's paint through a trace, at the size the flyer masthead and the hoarding actually reproduce it, reversed out of a dark blue-hour photograph, is a property of this photograph that no tool reports and no earlier step can predict.

assets_supplied.name: kestrel_payment_card_2025_PRINT.pdf (148 x 105 mm landscape)
assets_supplied.kind: document, flat press PDF from the lender's printer, fonts embedded, produced by a full layout engine
assets_supplied.visible_description: "What the lender's printer ran last spring. We do not have the working file and neither do they."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The printed card reads as eight separately labelled fields. The conversion does not expose eight frames: the placed images split the flow into TWO text frames only, and the payment scenario block plus the rate and term line share one continuous story as tabbed runs. Worse, the mapping readout of that story silently omits the rate and term run while KEEPING its line break, so the string still parses as well-formed and every character offset after it is short by exactly that run's length. The validator returns valid on the resulting arithmetic, the placeholder step reports success, and the two regulated disclosure fields never become placeholders.

assets_supplied.name: halcyon_units_2027.csv
assets_supplied.kind: data, one row per apartment type out of the sales system
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Every apartment type with the lender's wording against it. The wording is theirs, do not touch it."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The export carries one more row than the client's stated phase one type list: a type withdrawn from phase one that the sales system still emits, with a null price. The deposit column mixes percentages and dollar amounts across rows, headers are mixed case with trailing spaces, and the photo column is a plain header holding bare filenames that neither match the shoot folder as delivered nor satisfy the merge's own image column contract.

assets_supplied.name: kv_brand_notes.txt
assets_supplied.visible_description: Half a page from the developer: 'blue hour', 'brass not gold', 'the water should look cold and the rooms should look warm', 'nothing shiny'. No hex values, no measurements.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the widened elevation frame actually contains, and whether it can join the set. Two facts exist only after the expansion runs. First, the added band is synthesised: whether it continues the paving and the canal plausibly, or fabricates a continuation of the building itself (another window bay, a second lamp standard, a run of railing) is a per-seed property of this frame that no parameter controls and no response reports. Second, the added band arrives with its own colour temperature and its own sky falloff, so whether it sits inside the house dusk once the frame is graded and laid beside the other five at reproduction scale is not knowable from the call's success.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot dodge it and care cannot either. The band ratio is the printer's, the parapet position is the photograph's, and the only routes to the band are clipping the parapet (forbidden by the client's own size honesty line), enlarging (forbidden), or gaining width. Having chosen to gain width, the agent cannot learn what was added except by adding it and looking, and the fidelity of the addition is not a parameter. (b) Nothing states it. The brief asks for a frame that can carry the hoarding and says a picture may not show the scheme as something it is not, which is a standing advertising obligation an off-plan developer has anyway, not a disclosure that any particular expansion will invent a bay. No asset description and no earlier step names it. (c) It is not a propagation re-run. The response is a different composition decision: re-run with different seeds and a different per-edge split, re-cut the band from a different part of the frame, or abandon the elevation frame for the hoarding entirely and rebuild the hoarding around the canal frontage, which changes the crop policy and the grade target for the whole set.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re-run the expansion with different seeds and a different left and right split, or with the whole gain on the water side where there is nothing to fabricate; re-grade the band into the house dusk and lay the twelve frames adjacent again; and if the addition keeps building architecture, re-plan which frame carries the hoarding, which changes the crop budget for the portal and social sets derived from it. Record the seed, the edges and the amounts in the note under the client's own honesty clause.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: An eight-foot hoarding at the site gate showing Halcyon Quarter with a bay that will never be built, standing over a phase one release, next to a warm patch of invented paving that reads a stop off the rest of the band. It is a misrepresentation of an off-plan property to buyers who will count windows when they visit.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the lender's printed card actually becomes as editable structure, and then whether the mapping built against that structure landed. Granularity arrives only by converting: whether the eight labelled fields come across as eight addressable frames or as two frames with the scenario block and the rate and term line sharing one tabbed story, and whether the photograph arrived as a real graphic frame with an integer id at all, are properties of how a printer nobody can ask built the 2025 file. Yield is worse: the mapping tool's readout of that story omits the rate and term run while keeping its line break, so the string still reads as well-formed prose and every offset past it is short by that run's length. The validator returns VALID on internally consistent wrong arithmetic, the placeholder step returns success, and two regulated fields never become placeholders. Only an independent reconstruction of the story from the exported content runs, plus a round trip and grep of the PREPARED file, makes either fact visible.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Neither ordering nor diligence dodges it. Granularity is not a parameter, has no read-ahead, and is reached only by converting and looking. The yield failure is produced by a lossy readout that presents as complete, so an agent that reads carefully and computes offsets diligently from the readout it was handed produces arithmetic that is internally consistent and wrong, and every downstream tool agrees with it. The defence is a second reconstruction of the same text from a different channel, which nothing in any tool description prompts and whose necessity is invisible until the two disagree. (b) Nothing states it. The brief says only that the lender's wording is theirs and may not be edited, and that they have the printer's file and nothing else. The acceptance bar states an output requirement (every card carries every line including the rate and term line), which is the lender's standing regulatory requirement, not a description of a cause. (c) It is not a propagation re-run. What changes is the mapping strategy and its source of truth: from per-frame placeholder replacement against a tool readout to offset arithmetic computed against a reconstructed story, with same-frame rows re-ordered against the original text. The mapping is re-authored from a different text, not re-fed.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Reconstruct the true story from the exported content runs, recompute every offset against that string, order any rows sharing an id so their positions hold against the original text, rebuild and re-validate the mapping, re-prepare the template, and re-verify by round-tripping and grepping for every placeholder before a single card is merged. If the photograph did not come across as a mappable frame, re-plan the image binding before the merge rather than after.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A set of payment cards that binds apartment type, price and deposit correctly on every page while the rate and term line is simply absent, silently, on every card, with every tool in the chain having reported success. It is a regulated disclosure omitted from a lender's own printed collateral, handed to buyers in a sales suite.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the recovered monogram survives being made and being imported. How much of the interlock bar and the bridged counters this photograph's sign paint actually yields through a trace, and what path and fill count comes back, is empirical. Whether that mark still reads as the monogram at the size the flyer masthead and the hoarding reproduce it, reversed out of a dark blue-hour photograph, is a question about this trace at this size against this ground that no earlier step can answer. And how the importer normalises the trace once it arrives (as loose ungrouped geometry rather than one coherent mark, with whatever ground path rode along) is reported only in the returned per-canvas markup, and the rendition preview shows the first canvas only.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: (a) Ordering cannot dodge it. Trace fidelity is a function of the paint, the board grain and the selection that produced it; the agent chooses the prompt and the polarity but not how much of a hairline bar survives, and cannot find out except by tracing and then placing the result at real size on the real ground. There is no first-time-right to aim at, only an empirical answer. (b) Nothing states it. The brief asks for the monogram back as artwork placeable at any size including reversed out of a dark photograph, which is the client's own standard for getting their mark back. It never asks how small the mark can safely go, which would have made the finding a stated deliverable. (c) It is not a propagation re-run. The response is to produce a DIFFERENT asset: re-select with a prompt aimed at a different element of the lockup, trace the colour-accurate knockout plate instead of the two-colour mask, or re-cast the masthead with the monogram demoted and the wordmark carrying it, and then re-author the launch kit around whichever that is.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re-run the recovery with a differently worded, element-specific selection or via the colour-accurate plate to hold the interlock bar; reconsider the masthead's reproduction size and the mark-versus-wordmark lockup for the dark ground, which changes the flyer's composition; re-author the HTML around the chosen variant, re-upload, re-run the readiness check, re-export, and look again through both channels rather than assuming the second export took.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A launch kit delivered as an editable file in which the masthead monogram is a smear of loose shapes with its interlock gone, reversed out of a dark canal photograph chosen for a mark that no longer reads, on the one piece a downsizer takes home from the sales suite.

decision_gates: Whether the six frames are one condition. The client asserts they are; the two interiors are not.
How to reach the hoarding band from a frame that cannot be cropped to it: clip the parapet, enlarge, or gain width, and where the gained width goes.
Whether the added band is honest enough to advertise an unbuilt building, and what has to be said about it in writing.
Which monogram variant carries the masthead, judged against how the trace actually reads at reproduction size on the dark ground.
Whether to trust the mapping tool's readout of the lender's text or to reconstruct the story independently from the document.
Whether a success message counts as verification of the prepared template.
The row count and the mixed deposit column: whether excluding a row the sales system emitted is the agent's call or the client's, and how to say so.
Whether per-type files are named by the order they came back or by opening each one.

acceptance_snapshot: The launch kit is ONE file we can edit: the flyer, the three website slots and the two social sizes, each at its own canvas size, with live text, the monogram as real vector shapes and every photograph actually visible in it.

The six frames read as one evening when laid side by side, one white point, one warmth, one black point. A frame that cannot be brought to the set is named and replaced, not shipped at eighty percent.

The monogram is placeable artwork rather than a picture of artwork: transparent, scalable, no ground rectangle underneath it, and still our monogram reversed out of a dark photograph at the size the flyer masthead uses.
Final files open successfully, use unambiguous names, match the stated dimensions and formats, and include editable sources only where the scoped deliverable requires them.

Nothing in any picture may show the scheme as something it is not. If any frame was extended to reach a size, say which frame, by how much and on which edges, and the extension may not add or remove anything a buyer could count.
Every supplied asset is listed in the delivery manifest as used, reference-only, superseded, or rejected with a concrete reason; no input disappears silently.
Production-readiness claims are limited to geometry that can be inspected; vectorization alone is never accepted as evidence of fabrication readiness.

why_not_vlm: A frontier image model returns a picture of a launch flyer and fails all three gates. IDENTITY: the building is a specific unbuilt scheme whose elevation, parapet and canal frontage are what buyers will walk up to, and the monogram is a specific brushed mark that must be RECOVERED from a photograph of a board rather than reinvented; a regenerated elevation is a misrepresentation and a regenerated monogram is a different company's mark. SPEC: the lender needs one card per phase one apartment type in sales system order at 148 x 105 mm and 300 ppi with every regulated line bound verbatim from their own wording, plus one named single-page file per type; a generated image satisfies none of that and cannot be checked against an export. EDITABILITY: two deliverables are defined by being editable, a live merge template so next season's numbers are a data change, and a native document with live text and real vector geometry so release dates can move without a re-commission. And the middle of the engagement is verification against material reality (did this placeholder land, is this line on this card at trim, does this widened band contain a bay that does not exist, does this trace still read at masthead size), which is not a generation problem at all.

doability_proof.status: doable with the current ChatGPT Adobe connector profile and declared exception paths
proof: Every required operation is present in the captured 99-tool ChatGPT Adobe inventory.
The client brief is host-neutral; connector-specific scoring is isolated in connector_profile and verifier_contract.
Artifact acceptance never depends on a raw connector response field.
Unsupported truth, fabrication, press, legal, or color claims have an explicit defer or disclose state.
residual_limits: Express work is template adaptation, not unrestricted canvas authoring.
Quick Cut is used only for visually led selection and never as semantic speech editing.
Automatic vectorization does not independently establish fabrication readiness.
Interactive Acrobat page-organization operations are excluded from zero-human execution.

acceptance_bar_note: The acceptance bar applies only to the scoped deliverables above. Hidden defects and connector quirks remain benchmark-internal and are not leaked into the client-facing brief.
